title: Direct sum of a family of modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a set and $(M_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of $R$-modules (for $R=\mathbf Z$: of abelian groups). The *direct sum* $\bigoplus_{i\in I}M_i$ is the set of families $(m_i)_{i\in I}$ with $m_i\in M_i$ and $m_i=0$ for all but finitely many $i$, with componentwise addition $(m_i)+(m'_i)=(m_i+m'_i)$ and scalar multiplication $r(m_i)=(rm_i)$; it is an $R$-module. For $j\in I$ the *canonical inclusion* $\iota_j:M_j\to\bigoplus_iM_i$ is the $R$-linear map sending $m$ to the family with $j$-th entry $m$ and all other entries $0$, and the *$j$-th component* of $(m_i)$ is $m_j$. An element $(m_i)$ is the finite sum $\sum_{i:\,m_i\neq0}\iota_i(m_i)$.
